info.name: Unit Conversion API
info.description:
Import this collection. Set `baseUrl` if the API is not on http://localhost:5080 (dotnet run --launch-profile http).

`value1` / `value2` are the two sample inputs used for every conversion pair. Temperature uses its own pair because 0 and 32 are more useful than 1 and 2.5.

item.name: Length
item.description: Every length pair including identity. Two sample values from collection variables.

item.name: Mass
item.description: Every mass pair including identity. Two sample values from collection variables.

item.name: Temperature
item.description: Every temperature pair including identity. Two sample values from collection variables.

item.name: Volume
item.description: Every volume pair including identity. Two sample values from collection variables.
